title: mini wooden chests
text: mini wooden chests. Purchased these for a pirate treasure hunt .. they are tiny... about 4 or 5" long by about 3" wide... about 3" deep - eyeballing.  They are super cheap.  One of the boxes won't stay closed.  Total junk.  Worth about $2.  In my opinion.  The metal closures are very dingy - in the photos they look bright and clean.  As long as you're expecting a box worth about $2 - and you don't mind if they don't close, you'll be ok.  I would not recommend these.
